title: Alphabet, Exelon, and Patterson-UTI Just Paid Shareholders. Here’s What They Got.
summary: Three companies with nothing in common all sent checks to shareholders within the same two-day window, and the reasons behind each payment reveal something very different about where each business is headed.

title: Is PG&E Stock Cheap, Or Just Waiting On California?
summary: PG&E (PCG) has lost about 13% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 gained 17%. The California utility now trades at 9.5 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 22.9, the kind of gap value buyers hunt for. So what has the market marked down: the utility, or the state it operates in.
